study.question: Does removing per-impression magnitude from the 32-coordinate gate preactivation improve the utility of compact count/freshness evidence with grouped history, beyond an equal-capacity normalization effect on redundant statistics?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the baselines improve from static .6050036145 to pooling .6102261137 and DIN .6133619861. Count/freshness alone (.6186637742) and match groups (.6187998914) are close. Direct concatenation in g0-r0006-groups_evidence (.6185907798) does not beat either stronger source, whereas the separate g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness head reaches .6197365168. Its count/presence factorial contrasts are preliminary, not independent repetitions. In round 8, conditioned detailed evidence reaches .6197482130: only +.0000116962 over that residual head for +2176 parameters and 591.59 versus 582.69 wall seconds. Conditioning versus addition gains .0005376963 with detailed evidence and .0005103173 with redundant evidence, yielding only .0000273791 difference-in-differences. The additive detailed cell has better Logloss (.1957891603) than the AUC-leading multiplicative cell (.1958296124). Thus evidence-specific conditional advantage remains unsupported. Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics show tanh modulation RMS .77967 and max abs 1.0 (redundant multiplicative RMS .68832), consistent with some saturation but not evidence of a population-wide bottleneck or harm. Mechanism hypothesis: radial growth/variation of the learned context projection can make its tanh gate lose sensitivity to useful context direction; fixed-epsilon per-impression RMS normalization of its preactivation could retain directional evidence modulation while suppressing this scale dependence. This is an unverified local hypothesis; saturation can be useful and normalized gradients change too.

nearest_work.source_ref: craft-paper-v1 arxiv:2609.01655v1, text SHA256 035e94708a2fd02c4910c7946cd5e8dc2da789983fe95a1aea684d348ea04f68, section 4.2 lines 165-189
nearest_work.difference: Source uses reliability-weighted non-sequential context to generate transport coefficients, applies RMSNorm to transported intent/sequence states, and retains an initial-state path across depth. We inherit only the already present local contextual modulation and examine parameter-free RMS normalization of gate preactivations before tanh in a single residual classifier head. No reliability pooling, transport stack, distillation, or reproduction/priority claim. RMS normalization and contextual gates are existing ideas; nearest-work coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.

inherited_components: Exact g0-r0008-conditioned_evidence backbone and zero-initialized correction allocation; ancestral references are read-only.
All four exclusive match-group means and four log-count backbone statistics; overlapping group/action count and mean one-day exponential freshness blocks.
68->32 bias-free contextual projection; 32->32 ReLU evidence projection; bias-free final scalar correction multiplied by 1+tanh gate.
Detailed/redundant evidence replacement from g0-r0008; redundant repeats existing four backbone counts eight times, so equal width does not equal information rank.
Host training, validation, hashing, information boundary, cost ledger and checkpoint selection; no external or withheld data.
study.proposed_difference: Insert z_hat=z/sqrt(mean_j(z_j^2)+1e-6) for each impression after z=W_context*context and before tanh, with no affine or learned normalization parameters. The raw replacement uses z unchanged. Cross normalized/raw with detailed/redundant evidence in four standalone modules; every cell computes both forms and selects through a fixed config switch. Empty context still maps to zero; there are no batch statistics or cross-example dependencies. The backbone, evidence, correction width, final weight initialization, optimizer and loss are unchanged. This identifies the normalization package (forward scale plus derivative changes), not an exclusive saturation mechanism or a novel normalization method.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrasts: D=auc(rms_evidence)-auc(raw_evidence), R=auc(rms_redundant)-auc(raw_redundant), I=D-R. Predict D>0 and I>0; seek D>=0.0001 for a practically consequential first-seed signal. Report all four AUC/Logloss values, D/R/I, total and dense parameters, training/allocation/wall time, throughput, batch p50/p95 and peak memory; seed-42 results remain preliminary.

At the authorized frozen diagnostic sample, predict lower selected |tanh(z)|>.95 fraction and greater mean 1-tanh(z)^2 for normalized gates. Raw and normalized fractions are both measured on each checkpoint, controlling the immediate mathematical transform within that checkpoint. These are source-supplied local measurements, not independent performance attribution or full-population prevalence.

Normalizing should reduce the gate change when the same context vector is multiplied by two, up to epsilon; zero context remains zero and all-empty correction remains zero. Finite logits, padding invariance, exclusive partition coverage, cell count identities and zero-length/empty agreement must hold.

Compare raw_evidence/raw_redundant to g0-r0008-conditioned_evidence/g0-r0008-conditioned_redundant for execution reproducibility. Exact numerical identity across host kernels is not assumed; investigate material discrepancies before attribution. Historical comparison of normalized detailed to g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness tests whether the larger conditioning package earns its cost, without attributing that historical gap to normalization alone.
falsifiers: D<=0 leaves added normalization utility unsupported for this implementation. D>0 but I<=0 or differences too small relative to paired-seed variation supports at most a generic normalization/optimization benefit, not evidence-specific complementarity.

If normalization lowers saturation without improving validation AUC, the claim that saturation was a consequential predictive bottleneck lacks support. If AUC improves without the predicted diagnostic movement, do not claim saturation mitigation; retain optimization or amplitude regularization as alternatives.

Raw modulation reaching abs 1 or RMS .78 alone is insufficient to diagnose harmful saturation. If authorized diagnostics show little selected-coordinate saturation, revise the premise rather than promote it to a mechanism fact.

Padding, empty-history, finite-output or count-identity failures invalidate the implementation comparison. Host failures and incomplete calls are charged and retained; do not present them as scientific counterevidence.

Unrepeated gains, worse quality-cost frontier, or failure to beat the simpler residual head after repetition do not justify selecting a more complex deployment candidate. A null result does not refute all possible contextual evidence models.
alternative_explanations: Generic rescaling, changed gradient geometry or regularization can explain gains; this design does not separate instance-adaptive RMS normalization from a tuned fixed-temperature tanh. A future fixed-temperature replacement would test that narrower attribution.
Preactivation magnitude may encode history occupancy, support or certainty; normalization can discard useful information despite the backbone retaining counts and norms.

Only first-512 candidate-supplied diagnostics are available. They need not represent all users, times or rare behaviors. Frozen history-length/hour/composition/frequency slices remain exploratory, with supplied sample/positive/negative counts; do not invent unavailable missing-field slices.
Detailed and redundant evidence differ in rank, scale and occupancy semantics; the factorial addresses a broad evidence-dependent effect, not a fully distribution-matched information intervention.
Observed differences can reflect one seed, checkpoint selection and accumulated adaptive validation search. Same-seed reruns establish execution consistency, not independent mechanism replication.

Raw snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, histories are truncated at 128, and matching uses supplied hashed category/brand fields. Findings concern this frozen benchmark, not verified production point-in-time performance.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 11000 seconds for up to six capped follow-ups, including raw reproduction diagnosis or a prospective fixed-temperature control if justified. Never assume a failed/incomplete call costs zero, nor silently repeat an unknown-state execution. The full factorial is mandatory for an evidence-specific claim.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 22000 seconds for up to twelve capped validation-only calls: a frozen four-cell suite at paired seeds 42/43/44 (21131.19 seconds worst case). Reuse accepted same-input/protocol/source/seed outputs only if the host permits it, and retain already charged costs. Include the simpler residual parent as an additional closest comparison using attribution reserve if necessary. Freeze files, configs, hashes, seed suite and commands before final repetitions. No test scores, predictions or closed assessment archive may be requested or reused.
cost_plan.stop_rule: The host ledger is authoritative. Stop before any hard budget limit or when no complete useful contrast fits while preserving necessary attribution and assessment reserves; do not raise any cap. If reproduction/information integrity cannot be established, stop attribution and preserve receipts. Current proposal permits exactly four variants; no unregistered temperature/epsilon search. Numerical host execution remains required, so static checks cannot be called experimental success.

knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Parameter-free RMS normalization across 32 projected gate preactivations immediately before the inherited tanh; a raw replacement crosses detailed/redundant evidence. No transport stack, reliability weighting, memory path or distillation.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Normalizes the controller preactivation once at the classifier, whereas the source normalizes transported intent/sequence representations in a depth-wise context-conditioned residual block. Normalization and gates are inherited ideas; no priority claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: D<=0 or I<=0 leaves evidence-specific normalization utility unsupported; saturation reduction without predictive gain does not establish a useful bottleneck.
